description.text: Chinese Language Courses Basic Chinese Lecture 1: The Sounds of Chinese Some Essential Phrases Lecture 7: Actions Traveling Lecture 2: Introductions Other People Lecture 8: New friends, old friends Asking for it Lecture 3: Requests Locations Lecture 9: Festivals Chinese Life Lecture 4: Directions Time Lecture 10: The high life Happy endings Lecture 5: Describing things Likes and dislikes Lecture 11: Writing Lecture 6: Map & Dictionary What’s it like Lecture 12: Outline of Grammar for Review Textbook：Chinese Language Learning for Foreigners (I) Intermediate Chinese (At least 200 hours of studying Chinese Language is a prerequisite for this course) Lecture 1: Self-introduction and Name Card Writing Lecture 7: Bargaining Words Lecture 2: Making Phone Calls Lecture 8: Main Scenic Spots in China Lecture 3: Traffic in Qingdao Lecture 9: Sports Words Lecture 4: Picnics Lecture 10: Talking about Chinese Society Lecture 5: Going Shopping Lecture 11: Watching Beijing Opera Lecture 6: Lucky Words in China Lecture 12: Words for Farewell Party Textbook：Chinese Language Learning for Foreigners (Ⅱ) Chinese Culture Lecture 1: Introduction Dos and Don’ts Lecture 7: Calendar, Celebrations, Festivals and Customs Lecture 2: Great Thinkers and Philosophers Guanxi and Mianzi Lecture 8: Chinese Religion Lecture 3: Chinese Dynasties and Historical Events Lecture Lecture 9: Chinese Literature and Art Lecture 4: New China and Influencing Figures Lecture 10: Chinese Cuisine Lecture 5: Chinese Language and Ambiguity Lecture 11: Chinese Medicine an d Massage, Qigong Lecture 6: Chinese Education and Morality Lecture 12: Dynamic Changes in Chinese Value System Textbooks：1. A Brief Introduction to Chinese History & Culture 2. Chinese Business Etiquette 3. Art of War

duration.text: The Chinese Language at Qingdao Hismile College is a 0 N/A long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 666 USD/per week ￥ 4800 CNY/per week

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Certificate/Diploma of highest education

requirements.text: The applicants need to have a formal education background at the high school level or above, a good moral character, be aged 18-55 and in good health.
